tasks.title: Generalize buildDeviceArgv(tool, toolPath, device, command) with a selector-segment-scoped NFR-5 check
tasks.description: Replace the positional adb-only argv builder with a per-tool `when` producing a SELECTOR SEGMENT (adb `-s` prefix / simctl positional-after-subcommand / idb `--udid`), asserting `check(selector.count { it == device.value } == 1)` over that segment only — never the whole argv, because DeviceCommand.GetProp carries free text that can legally equal the udid. Append the command payload afterwards, checked only against the connect/-H/-P denylist. Android-only commands on an iOS tool throw a documented DeviceCommandException. Update the one Android call site (DeviceCommandExecutorImpl, still unrenamed at this point) to pass ToolKind.Adb explicitly.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The NFR-5 check is scoped to the selector segment the when(tool) produced, NOT argv as a whole
simctl's selector is positional-after-subcommand (`simctl io <udid> screenshot ...`), not a -u flag
DeviceCommandExecutorImpl's one call site compiles against the new 4-arg signature

tasks.expectedOutput: buildDeviceArgv generalized; Android call site updated; function is the single argv construction point for all three ToolKinds.
tasks.hypothesis: A whole-argv count would turn DeviceCommand.GetProp's legal free-text payload into a crash the moment it equals the udid — scoping to the selector segment removes that trap while keeping the security property intact.
definitionOfDone: buildDeviceArgv compiles for all three ToolKinds
The one Android call site updated and still compiles
